signUp.title: Sign up for Zentlet
signUp.consent: I have read and accept the <terms>Terms of Service</terms> and the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>, and I consent to Zentlet processing my personal data, including my income and expenses (sensitive data under Peru's Law 29733), to provide the service.

checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.body: We sent a link to {email} to confirm your account. It may take a couple of minutes; check your spam folder too.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.description: We'll send you a link to choose a new one. <link>Back to sign in</link>
forgotPassword.sentBody: If an account exists for {email}, you'll get a link to choose a new password. It expires in 1 hour.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.description: Saving it will sign you out everywhere else.
resetPassword.doneBody: You can now sign in with your new password. <link>Sign in</link>
resetPassword.invalidTitle: This link is no longer valid
resetPassword.invalidBody: It may have expired or already been used. <link>Request a new one</link>

validation.nameTooShort: Name must be at least {min} characters
validation.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least {min} characters

terms: By clicking continue, you agree to our <terms>Terms of Service</terms> and <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.

record.title: Every expense in its place
record.body: Record a transaction in seconds and watch it add up for the month.

balance.title: Your balance at a glance
balance.body: Income and expenses for the period in a single number.

categories.title: Categories that make sense
categories.body: See where your money goes without opening a spreadsheet.

errors.userAlreadyExists: An account with that email already exists.
errors.userAlreadyExistsUseAnotherEmail: An account with that email already exists. Sign in or use another one.
errors.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.
errors.emailNotVerified: Your email isn't verified yet. We've sent the confirmation link again.
errors.failedToCreateUser: We couldn't create your account. Please try again.
errors.offline: You're offline. Check your internet connection and try again.
errors.tooManyRequests: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.unreachable: We couldn't reach the server. Please try again.
errors.fallback: We couldn't complete that action. Please try again.
errors.legalConsentRequired: To create your account you must accept the Terms and the Privacy Policy.
errors.captchaFailed: We couldn't verify you're not a robot. Please try again.

oauthErrors.accessDenied: You cancelled access. You can try again whenever you want.
oauthErrors.accountNotLinked: That email already has an account. Sign in with your email and password.
oauthErrors.fallback: We couldn't sign you in with that provider. Please try again.
oauthErrors.signupRequired: There's no account with that email. Sign up to create one.
